originalEntry.title: Showreel with a code-synthesized, beat-synced soundtrack
originalEntry.title_zh: 配乐代码合成的动效作品集
originalEntry.author: prasenx
originalEntry.description: The showreel prompt extended with a fully code-synthesized soundtrack, cuts locked to the beat and a 1080p 60fps MP4 output; made in Cursor.
originalEntry.description_zh: 「动效作品集」提示词加强版：配乐全用代码合成、剪辑踩拍、输出 1080p 60fps MP4，在 Cursor 里完成。
originalEntry.prompt:
make a dynamic 15-second motion graphics video that shows what an incredible motion designer you are, like it's your showreel for a résumé. go all out.

compose the soundtrack yourself, fully synthesized in code. no samples, no audio files, no VST instruments. every cut and transition must land on the beat.

1920x1080, 60fps. render the final video with the music mixed in as an MP4 and tell me where it's saved.
originalEntry.prompt_zh:
制作一段 15 秒的动态图形视频，展示你是多么出色的动效设计师，就像简历里的作品集一样。拿出全部本事。

自己创作配乐，完全用代码合成。不用采样、不用音频文件、不用 VST 音源。每个剪辑点和转场都必须踩在拍子上。

1920x1080，60fps。把混入音乐的最终视频渲染成 MP4，并告诉我保存在哪里。
originalEntry.note_zh: 作者称只用了一个提示词。
